news.headline: Consumer Tech (Oct 2-6): Big Earnings Dominate Headline, Meta, Google Face Political And Regulatory Pressure Over AI Expansion & More
news.summary: Meta faces political pressure over data center development, while Google encounters criticism over AI in schools and major technology stocks report quarterly results.

news.headline: JOST Werke SE: Regulatory Disclosure under the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG)
news.summary: JOST Werke SE has published a regulatory disclosure in accordance with Article 40, Section 1 of the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG).

news.headline: Trump Signals Cabinet Shake-Up After Midterm Losses — Says 'Maybe a Few Changes'
news.summary: Trump signals cabinet changes after Democrats win Congress, amid departures, impeachment calls and a pitch for Dana White as press secretary.

news.headline: Trump Offers UFC Boss Dana White White House Press Secretary Job — Wants MMA Fighters as Aides
news.summary: Trump says he offered UFC’s Dana White the White House press secretary job amid rapid turnover, urging him to recruit MMA fighters as aides.

news.headline: AUTO1 Group SE: Release according to Article 40, Section 1 of the WpHG
news.summary: AUTO1 Group SE has published a regulatory notification in accordance with the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG).

news.headline: Regulatory Implementation of Benefit Card Interoperability in Brazil
news.summary: New Brazilian regulations for the Worker's Food Program (PAT) mandate interoperability and fee caps for benefit card providers, including Pluxee.

news.headline: Kempower Oyj Reports Managers' Transactions
news.summary: Kempower Oyj has released a regulatory disclosure regarding transactions involving its managers and Otava.
